identity.gauge_sha256: record raw NERSC file SHA-256 per configuration
identity.propagator_sha256: record cached propagator byte SHA-256 per configuration
identity.quda: record version string and libquda build hash
identity.device: record DCU model, driver and runtime
identity.trajectory_ids: join each configuration ID to the HMC manifest trajectory

checks.source: point at the origin; 12 spin-color right-hand sides
checks.fast_generic_consistency: same sink channel via both paths
checks.source_averaging: average over sources inside a configuration, then block across configurations

statistics.power_simulation: target effect vs block variance, pre-registered seed

freeze.score_spec: Diagnostic-only paired risk difference; physical certification withheld unless reference and anchor checks pass.
freeze.primary_endpoint: Paired configuration-block risk difference, reported with block-bootstrap interval and explicit abstention count; anchor chain is a separate HMC initialization.
freeze.validation_ids: S16T16D IDs 140-199; do not read before candidate/score freeze.
freeze.access_log: S16T16D validation IDs 140-199 have not been read as of 2026-11-20T02:07:21Z.
freeze.cross_task_holdout_access: Freeze each participating task protocol, candidate set, score or endpoint, source hashes, and analysis before the first read. Access the shared holdout once; cross-task reuse is correlated evidence and must not be counted as independent samples.
freeze.holdout_amendment: The original HMC chain protocol proposed D IDs 100-119 as a Pion anchor. This measurement-plan amendment supersedes that proposal: the independent anchor is S16T16E IDs 0-59; S16T16D IDs 100-139 are a gap. Do not rewrite the historical HMC receipt.

budget.estimated_hours: Measured from the submitted run receipt; no estimate is asserted in advance.

stop_rules: Gauge hash, trajectory manifest, ensemble, or geometry mismatch -> stop before inversion.
Any of the 12 spin-color residuals exceeds 1e-10 or is non-finite -> stop and retain the failing row.
Development reference gate fails -> retain measurements as diagnostic only and do not issue a physical candidate score.
The independently seeded S16T16E anchor fails the frozen reference-consistency gate -> do not open S16T16D validation.
Validation is opened only after development artifacts and candidate/score specification are frozen.
